content: For bootstrapped apps (e.g. on Supabase), PostGIS is the recommended geospatial solution over geohashing: store points as GEOGRAPHY(POINT,4326), GiST index, use ST_DWithin for radius queries and <-> operator for nearest-neighbor sort. Geohashing/Redis GEO is only needed for high-frequency moving-entity tracking (e.g. live driver location), not relevant for static listing pins.
